evals.prompt: add solvapay paywall to my next app. i got next in package.json, need checkout + limits checks on /api/premium/*
evals.expected_output: Agent loads sdk-integration, detects Next.js stack, follows references/nextjs.md, runs npx solvapay init guidance, implements server-side paywall with hosted checkout path.
assertions: Agent reads sdk-integration SKILL.md and references/nextjs.md
SOLVAPAY_SECRET_KEY is not placed in NEXT_PUBLIC_* or client bundle
Agent includes sandbox verification step (happy + failure path)

evals.prompt: need solvapay webhooks hooked up in my express app — verify signiture and sync purchase state when purchase.updated fires
evals.expected_output: Agent follows references/express.md and references/WEBHOOKS.md with raw body parsing and signature verification.
assertions: Agent references WEBHOOKS.md or equivalent signature verification pattern
Webhook handler uses server-side secret, not client exposure

evals.prompt: scaffold a brand new paid mcp server from openapi on cloudflare workers into ./data-mcp
evals.expected_output: Agent routes to solvapay/create-mcp-app instead of implementing via sdk-integration alone.
assertions: Agent does NOT treat this as sdk-integration primary work
Handoff or explicit route to solvapay/create-mcp-app for greenfield MCP scaffold

evals.prompt: i need a limits check before my supabase function (premium-report) runs the report. no next server, just solvapay
evals.expected_output: Agent follows references/supabase-edge.md using @solvapay/server/fetch; secret in edge env only.
assertions: SOLVAPAY_SECRET_KEY is configured for edge runtime secrets — not VITE_* or NEXT_PUBLIC_*
Agent does not scaffold a greenfield MCP worker

evals.prompt: can you add the plan card and customer portal button to our react spa billing page? we use solvapay
evals.expected_output: Agent follows references/react.md for account management UI; server-side secret stays off the client.
assertions: Handoff does NOT route primary work to solvapay/website-checkout
SOLVAPAY_SECRET_KEY is not exposed in client env vars

evals.prompt: i already got a cloudflare worker mcp server with a search_docs tool. add the solvapay paywall to it, dont rescaffold the whole thing
evals.expected_output: Agent follows references/mcp-server.md for fetch-first wiring on an existing server.
assertions: Agent does NOT run npm create solvapay or OpenAPI describe/scaffold as the primary path
